gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed intracranial glioblastoma (per WHO 2021 definition) following surgical resection.

candidate_evidence.quote: evaluate the safety of ascending radioactive dose levels of 131I-TLX101 administered intravenously in combination with best standard of care in newly diagnosed GBM patients

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have had prior surgery for glioblastoma, but no systemic therapy or radiation therapy for GBM.
131I-TLX-101 for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma (IPAX-2)

role_evidence.quote: 131I-IPA: injection/solution administrated intravenously via infusion in ascending doses

agents.drug_class_hint: iodine-131 labelled 4-iodo-L-phenylalanine (131I-IPA, TLX101), LAT1-targeted investigational radiopharmaceutical; isotope 131I

role_evidence.quote: Plan to begin chemoradiation therapy 3-6 weeks after surgical resection with Stupp regimen.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention; listed as soc_backbone because every patient receives the Stupp regimen (eligibility) and the arm is '+ standard of care'. 18F-FET appears only as an 'other name' of the registered intervention 131I-IPA; listed as diagnostic_agent. Moiety for 131I-TLX101 given as development code without isotope (no INN stated).
